static_traits.name: Zhang Tao
static_traits.family_status: Lives with mother, Father has passed away
static_traits.social_status: Relationship with Mother is tense because she does not approve of Zhang Tao's hobbies; has friends who do LARP together, but he finds it difficult to open up to friends about inferiority and Sense of guilt
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe thoughts and feelings concretely; overall tone negative, pessimistic about the future; skeptical toward positive feedback; catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking, personalization, mind reading and other cognitive patterns visible in the narrative

basic_info.main_problem: Because I like playing LARP with friends in the woods, I feel judged by Mother, and this makes me feel inferior and a Sense of guilt.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling, because this guilt and inferiority have affected my mental health and my relationship with Mother.
growth_experiences: After Father's death, Zhang Tao began seeking more comfort and belonging in LARP (dressing up as characters for dramatic performances), but Mother does not approve of this hobby, and this became one source of his feeling judged and Sense of guilt.

Continuing to Live with mother since age 32, Zhang Tao continuously feels negation and misunderstanding of his interests and lifestyle in interactions with Mother, and this long-term situation has deepened his emotional cycle of 'being judged — inferiority — guilt'.

Socially, Zhang Tao has a friend group with shared interests, but he finds it difficult to reveal his inferiority and guilt to friends, tending to bear negative feelings alone, intensifying the experience of isolation.

core_beliefs: I am not recognized/not mature enough

special_situations.event: Talking with Mother about or preparing to attend LARP activities, and seeing Mother's disapproving look
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am still keen on role-playing games as an adult, Mother (and others) will look down on me, indicating I am immature
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing expressing hobbies to Mother, trying to Interpretation to gain Mother's understanding and approval
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She must think I am very childish, good-for-nothing.

special_situations.event: After doing LARP activities alone or recalling them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I persist with this hobby, I am shaming Mother, indicating something is wrong with me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-blame and guilt; avoids expressing his passion in front of family
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault, I have disappointed Mother.

special_situations.event: When thinking of submitting the finished manuscript to a publisher
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my works cannot stand out or become bestsellers, I am a complete failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinating on submissions, repeated Self-denial, difficulty starting new projects
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This book surely cannot compete with those bestsellers, I will fail completely.

special_situations.event: Friends give positive feedback after reading the manuscript
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' praise is not credible, positive feedback does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores positive information, focuses only on potential flaws
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just being polite, cannot be taken seriously.

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and accepted by Mother (and important others), while having his choices and passions as an adult seen
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being belittled as childish and a failure, Being rejected or humiliated
defense_goal: Through Self-denial and compliance to reduce conflict and shame with Mother
Avoiding risks (such as submitting works, revealing interests) to reduce the possibility of being negated

object_relations.self_representation: guilty, a 'not mature enough' child who needs recognition
object_relations.object_representation: critical, disapproving, a Mother/authority figure with a judgmental gaze

object_relations.self_representation: easily negated, a creator with unstable worth

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others (such as friends or the counselor) affirm her work or point out her strengths
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing the other person is praising only out of politeness or sympathy, and the real evaluation must be negative
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Respond to affirmation in a reserved, downplaying tone, emphasizing 'just being polite', then listing possible flaws of the works to Undo the other's positive evaluation.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to think about work outcomes or self-worth, images of the two poles 'success or failure' quickly come to mind
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Dividing situations into all good or all bad, unable to integrate the middle ground
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use absolute wording (such as 'complete failure/utterly hopeless'), tone resolute, avoiding discussion of middle possibilities.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Feeling disapproval in interactions with Mother or seeing her displeased expression
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turning external dissatisfaction into excessive self-blame, believing 'It is all my fault'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Lowering volume, self-denigration, frequent apologies or self-blame, avoiding expressing different opinions to ease tension.

manifestations: Feeling constrained by Mother's judgment in lifestyle and interest choices, finding it difficult to express passions autonomously (LARP and writing)
In career/creative choices (such as whether to submit), avoiding due to fear of being negated
Although friends are supportive, difficult to reveal inferiority and guilt to friends
On key decisions and emotional experiences, tends to bear them alone
After father's death, turned to LARP for comfort and connection
After changes in family structure, more sensitive to Mother's evaluations
outcomes: Rising Anxiety about being abandoned and negated
Stronger need for acceptance in intimate relationships

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequent Self-denial (such as 'this will fail completely'), daring not to accept positive feedback
Hesitant about submitting works and starting new projects, excessively worrying about consequences

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Projecting self-criticism as others' intentions: believing Mother 'looks down on me', friends are 'just being polite'
Presumes others' negative evaluations without clear evidence

exception_events.target_problem: When facing creative outcomes and fierce competition, Zhang Tao usually suffers insomnia due to catastrophizing and Self-doubt, reduced motivation, and avoids submitting works or starting new projects.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Recently, Zhang Tao completed his first book and had friends read it, receiving positive feedback; persisting in polishing the story and character development despite strong doubts.
exception_events.reason: Different actions: sustained focus on plot and character Shaping; different support: friends' trial reading and affirmation; different understanding: recognizing one's own investment and passion in creation.

exception_events.target_problem: In situations of fearing being negated, Zhang Tao usually reduces self-disclosure, unwilling to let others evaluate his works.
exception_events.unique_outcome: He proactively gave the manuscript to several friends to read and received positive evaluations, which differs from the previous pattern of avoiding evaluation.
exception_events.reason: Different actions: proactively seeking peer feedback; different support: friend group and shared interests bringing a sense of security; contextual clues: having some confidence in the work's unique plot.

positive_force: Can commit long-term and complete complex tasks (has completed the first book)
Has a stable passion for creating and LARP (intrinsic motivation)
Has friends with the same interests and a certain degree of social support
Can identify unique plots and character strengths of the work, has self-observation ability
negative_force: Self-worth highly depends on external recognition, prone to mind reading and personalization
Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking Reinforce failure Anticipation, leading to Procrastination and avoidance
Negating positive feedback makes confidence difficult to accumulate
In Family relationships, highly sensitive to Mother's evaluations, easily falling into the guilt-self-blame cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophizing worry about the success or failure of works and avoidance of submitting / starting new projects
antecedent: Thinking about submitting the manuscript to publishers
Recalling competition and failure possibilities at night
Talking with others about the prospects of one's work
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and black-and-white cognition about failure, and high dependence on external approval (mind reading and personalization)
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential rejection and shame, reducing Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: insomnia, Decreased drive, difficulty starting new projects, Self-efficacy continuously damaged

target_behavior.behavior: Self-blame and guilt reactions (personalization) occurring when discussing LARP with Mother
antecedent: When discussing with Mother or preparing to attend LARP
target_behavior.core_reason: Introjecting 'adult norms' as self-standards, and attributing Mother's dissatisfaction to self-defects through mind reading and personalization
target_behavior.function: Maintaining superficial harmony in relationships and avoiding conflict escalation through self-blame and compliance
target_behavior.consequence: Continuously tense relationship with Mother, Impaired self-esteem, reduced self-expression and openness about hobbies
